d: Jet black, straight hair flows down to the hips with long bangs framing a mature, youthful face. The eyes are obscured by a white and silver organic mask-like growth that covers the upper face, leaving only a calm expression visible. The build is slender and tall, dressed in a flowing white and black traditional gown with wide sleeves and a red accent at the chest. Signature details include a large, silver organic structure emerging from the head, a vivid crimson hand on the right arm, and wisps of black and red smoke swirling around the base of the attire and shoulders.
